risks.title: Interest Rate Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Item 7A, with an estimated impact of $13.5 million in case of a 1% increase in interest rates. This exposure is related to $1.35 billion of variable-rate debt through Term Loan Facilities.

risks.title: Commodity Price Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Aluminum costs, including the impact of high import tariffs, negatively affected gross margin in 2025, particularly in the second half. Gross margin declined by 20 basis points.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation impacts labor and production costs. The company implemented annual wage adjustments and additional investments in base wages in the third quarter of 2025.

risks.title: Dependence on the Coca-Cola Brand
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the Coca-Cola brand, which represents approximately 85% of its bottle and can sales. Loss of a contract or deterioration in the brand's reputation could have a significant impact on the company.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to the risk of customer payment defaults, which could affect receivables recovery and cash flow.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Potential changes in laws and regulations regarding tariffs, product labeling, and environmental standards could impact the company's operations and costs.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may face potential legal proceedings that could impact its reputation and financials.

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Incidents affecting product quality or company practices could impact consumer trust and the reputation of the partner Coca-Cola brand.
